name: Barley Loaf
description: A flat dark loaf, still warm from the settlement oven.
benefit: Feeds one traveller for a day.
cost: It goes stale in three days.

name: Flask of Lamp Oil
description: Olive oil in a sealed clay flask.
benefit: Keeps a lamp burning through one night.
cost: The flask is fragile and the oil is heavy for its worth.

name: Linen Bandage
description: A strip of boiled linen rolled tight.
benefit: Binds a wound and stops the bleeding.
cost: It does nothing for a wound that is already deep.

name: Pitch Torch
description: A reed bundle soaked in pitch.
benefit: Lights a tunnel for an hour.
cost: It smokes and every guard in the tunnel can see it.
